prosedurHalal.judul: Halal Certification Procedure: Independent vs Assisted by RuangHalal
advantages: Complete guidance from start to certificate issuance

steps.title: SIHALAL System Registration
steps.mandiri: Must create an account in the SIHALAL system. Technical guide is complicated. Wrong input may cause the process to repeat.
steps.bantuan: We help register your account, ensuring all inputs meet BPJPH requirements.

steps.title: Determining Business Category
steps.mandiri: Need to understand product classification, self-declare vs. regular scheme.
steps.bantuan: We help analyze your business and select the best scheme.

steps.title: SJH Training
steps.mandiri: Must find training institution independently with limited time.
steps.bantuan: We help register according to your schedule.

steps.title: Halal Document Preparation
steps.mandiri: Must prepare SJH, raw materials, suppliers. All must be complete.
steps.bantuan: We help prepare documents with easy-to-fill formats.

steps.title: Internal Audit & Supervisor
steps.mandiri: Must appoint a supervisor, understand reporting and documentation.
steps.bantuan: We provide audit templates and assist with training.

steps.title: Certification Submission
steps.mandiri: Manual upload, format must be correct, often causes errors.
steps.bantuan: We help upload and ensure completeness.

steps.title: LPH Audit Process
steps.mandiri: Scheduling and audit preparation can be complicated.
steps.bantuan: We help with preparation and coordination with LPH.

steps.title: Fatwa & Halal Determination
steps.mandiri: Difficult to monitor, don't know where to follow up.
steps.bantuan: We help monitor and update your progress.

steps.title: Halal Certificate Issuance
steps.bantuan: We send it directly once the certificate is issued.
